messages:
nina: Heads-up: we found a chained vuln in our runtime shim during nightly fuzzing (local privesc via SUID helper). We need a short coordinated rebuild + audit validation. Can people own: RBAC gating, key availability in staging, and audit query verification?

sergio: I can handle RBAC gating. Suggest we tighten the signer SA so it only has AsymmetricSign on the specific staging key and a condition limiting retrieval from the staging namespace. Will draft terraform.

lee: Ill take key propagation and CI KEY_URI rotation during the window. Plan: create a staging key in keyRings/image-signing-staging, pre-create pubkey and store in secret manager, then swap KEY_URI in CI at runtime.

nina: For audit: we need to ensure KMS AsymmetricSign and IAM.Policy changes show up in our sink (pubsub -> splunk). audit-bot, can you confirm the sink status?

audit-bot: audit-bot: sink splunk-forwarder exists and status: OK. Last successful export 2026-03-19T22:04:12Z. No recent AsymmetricSign from staging key in last 24h.

sergio: Terraform sketch (will PR):
```
resource "google_service_account_iam_binding" "ci_signer_staging" {
  service_account_id = google_service_account.ci_signer.email
  role               = "roles/cloudkms.signer"
  members            = ["serviceAccount:staging.ci.svc.id.goog[ci/signer]"]
  condition {
    title      = "limit-staging-key"
    expression = "resource.name==\"projects/redwood-staging/locations/global/keyRings/image-signing-staging/cryptoKeys/cosign-staging\""
  }
}
```

lee: On CI, Ill add a preflight job that runs: `cosign sign --key $KEY_URI test.json && gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName:"AsymmetricSign"' --limit 5` and fail if audit event not seen within 90s.

nina: Canary plan: rebuild images, publish -canary tag, deploy to canary namespace (5% traffic), run smoke and vuln scanners for 15m, then promote. If signing fails: stop, revert tag, open #image-incident and follow runbook.

sergio: I'll add an IAM condition that also restricts binding to a timestamp window using `request.time` so we narrow the exposure during cutover. Example condition: `request.time < timestamp("2026-03-21T04:00:00Z")`.

lee: I'll also ensure the staging key has rotation policy and pre-created backup key for instant failover. CI will attempt failover to `cosign-staging-backup` if first key errors with 403.

nina: Quick runbook snippets we should paste into the incident doc:
- Check gcloud logging for 403s: `gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.status.code=7 AND protoPayload.methodName="AsymmetricSign"' --limit 50`
- Who used the key: `gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName:"AsymmetricSign"' --format='value(protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail, resource.name)' --limit 50`
- If missing audit: check sink status `gcloud logging sinks describe splunk-forwarder`

sergio: Opening PR with tf and condition now. Will tag @nina for review.

lee: Ive added a minimal CI change to set KEY_URI from secret manager and a smoke signer job. Will push PR in ~20m.

nina: Thanks. Plan: dry-run tomorrow 02:00 UTC, actual window 03:30 UTC if all green. Keep updates here and call the incident channel if anything unexpected.

audit-bot: audit-bot: PR checks (sergio/iam-restrict) passed.
